'''Brug D'Shar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] who worked as an [[Aide/Legends|aide-de-camp]] to [[Senior Counselor]] [[Westa Impeveri]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], D'Shar participated in a discussion on the nature of the benefits and problems caused to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] by the world's [[Platform city|platform cities]]. During the debate, D'Shar argued that the platform cities were beneficial to the economy of Cularin.
